caption: The drawing depicts a female figure standing in the center of a blank, off-white background. She has short, curly brown hair and a round face with pink cheeks and small red lips. She is wearing a long, dark blue dress with large, puffy sleeves that reach her elbows, and a green bodice. Over her dress, she has a light-colored apron with horizontal red stripes and a wide red waistband tied around her waist. Her feet are visible, wearing red pointed shoes. The overall composition is simple, with the figure taking up a small portion of the page and no other objects or background elements present. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's signature "Marie Littell 40" is written in black ink.
title: Wooden Doll
